environment.description: Same Quarkus 2.16 native serverless function deployed on EKS 1.27 in namespace 'workflow-prod'. Pod runs with default service account. Calico CNI v3.25 with a namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy resource (name: 'wf-egress-restrict') that specifies spec.podSelector matchLabels app=workflow-handler, spec.policyTypes=['Egress'], with spec.egress containing a single rule allowing TCP port 443 to CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 only. The policy has no rule permitting egress to 169.254.169.254/32 or any link-local range. Note: Calico's default behavior when a NetworkPolicy with Egress policyType is applied is to deny all egress not explicitly allowed (implicit deny). Commons-collections 3.2.1 remains on classpath. No JVM deserialization filters. Pod label matches: app=workflow-handler.
